hole by hole.

Each hole is made and finished by hand from real timber and real turf. Nothing is inflatable, which is why it looks right on a hotel lawn beside a wedding tent. Here's how a hire plays out.

Good to know.

The questions we get asked most. If yours isn't here, send us a message and we'll get back to you.

Ask us on Instagram
How much space do I need?
Our course can be tailored to suit your venue. We can add or remove holes to fit the space you have available.
Where do you operate?
We're based in Cork and available across Ireland. We deliver, set up and collect the course at your venue.
How long is the hire?
Our standard hire is 4 hours, giving your guests plenty of time to enjoy the course.
Do you deliver?
Yes. We deliver, set up and collect the course, so you don't have to worry about a thing.
Can it be used indoors and outdoors?
Absolutely. Our course is suitable for both indoor and outdoor venues, with the venue's permission.
Is it suitable for all ages?
Yes. From children to grandparents, everyone can join in the fun.
